description: This file provides an implementation of an ANSI reader for Windows consoles, translating input events into ANSI sequences for terminal emulation, specifically VT100, on Windows systems.

classes.name: ansiReader
classes.description: A struct that wraps a Windows console input file to provide ANSI sequence translation.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the wrapped console input file.

methods.name: Fd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor of the wrapped console input.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads translated ANSI input bytes from the console.
